tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jig rten gsum snang bar byed pa'i lcags kyu mgon po chags pa'i rdo rje'i man ngag bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ dpal mgon po chags pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// bsnyen cing bsgrub pas 'jig rten gsum dgug cing*// dbang du byed pa'i nus mthu bsam pa yi// ra bar ma zin yud kyis lag pa'i rtser// thob 'dis 'dud do chags pa'i rdo rje la'o// khyod mthu'i rjes 'gro ting nge 'dzin dang sngags// sreg blugs man ngag gsar pa'i zla tshes ni// snyigs dus chos pa'i rkyen du rtsom pa'i mkhar// rngom brjid shar 'di 'bar ba'i sgron ma bzhin// 1$0000220sa dang sa 'og sa bla'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi cod pan bcings ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa gzhug byed cing nam mkha'i mdzod bsgrub par 'dod pas/ ye shes kyi mgon po chags pa'i rdo rje bsgrub par bya'o// 'di la/ bsnyen sgrub las la sbyor ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ skye bo 'du ba'i gnas su stan dmar po gtsang ma dga' ba 'khyil pas brgyan pa la pad+ma'i skyil mo krung bcas te/ byams pa tshad med pa'i sems kyis sems can thams cad la chags shing dbang du bsdu ba'i bsam pas/1$0000280 oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba ngharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dhā+o3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma rā ga'i rang bzhin zla gam gyi dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'khrug pa'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po/ nyi ma la baṃ pho mo bsnol ba'i khrir hūm̐ g.yas g.yon du ī dang gaḥde yongs su gyur pa las lcags kyu dmar po sa bon gyis mtshan pa gsum/ de las dbang du bsdu ba'i nus pa thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags bzhin du bsdus/ de la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mthu stobs kyi mgon po chags pa'i rdo rje 'char ka'i mdangs ltar dmar zhing nyi ma bye ba'i 'od zer dang mtshungs pa'i gzi brjid kyis srid pa gsum dbang du byed pa'i sku/ zhal gcig khro la chags pa'i nyams byams pas dmar ba'i spyan gsum zlum pa/ 'bar ba'i smin ma ser po dang sma ra ag tshom/

phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang po 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu/ gnyis pa ral gri g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ gnyis pa pad+ma'i kha ṭ+wāṃ/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba 'gying bag dang bcas pas shin tu 'jigs shing gzhan gyis mi thub ba'i zil chen po ston pa/ dgos 'dod thams cad ster ba'i nor bu'i rgyal po thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ glang po'i pags pa stod du gyon zhing stag sham lhug par dkris pa/ srung byed dmar mo gsung gi yum shin tu gzhon pa sgeg mo'i lang tsho can lcags kyu 'phyar zhing thod khrag stob pa dang gnyis su med par tsan dan 'khyil ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ g.yas su dbang phyug chen po dang*/ g.yon du tshogs bdag glang po che'i gdong pa can gnyis ka shin tu brjid cing dmar ba'i sku phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin cing gtso bo la 'dud pa'i gar gyis rol pa me'i klong na gnas pa/ thugs kar nyi ma la sa bon/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'i rnam par nam mkha'i mthar thug par spros/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad skyong pa'i mgon po yab yum dbang phyug dang tshogs kyi bdag po thams cad kyi thugs kar lcags kyus btab/ zhags pas bcings/ lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ dril bus mnyes/ bskal pa'i rlung lta bu'i shugs kyis bteg ste dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang sa bon gyi 'od bung ba'i mchu lta bu sna g.yas nas 'thon/ sangs rgyas yab yum sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo khro mo'i tshogs kyi shangs g.yas nas zhugs/ de dag gis dbang du sdud pa'i nus mthu'i thig le 'jibs te shangs g.yon nas 'ongs/ sna sgo g.yon nas zhugs te spyi bo nas lus kyi gnas thams cad du khyab par dbang bskur bas dbang gi las bsgrub pa'i dbang phyug chen po'i gnas thob par bsam/ oṃ mahā kā la shu ra ni e mañdzu kup+ta hūm̐ ka bhe ra ko bhi ra ga na pa ti swā hā/

1$0000220zhes pas gtso bo'i sa bon gyi mthar byu ru'i 'phreng bas bskor ba lta bur dmigs te bzlas pa'i dus/ 1$0000280sngags 'phreng las 'od 'phros/ 'khor gnyis kyi srog gi sa bon la thim/ gnyis su med par 'dres pas gnad du gzir srog lhag par bskul bas rang dbang thams cad dang bral bar bdag nyid kyi dbang du 'dus par 1$0000220bsam mo// thun mtshams su gtor ma 1$0000280swa bhā wa1$0000220sa sbyangs/ 1$0000280mdun du yaṃ las 1$0000220zhes sogs kyis byin gyis brlab/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar 1$0000280ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi 1$0000220btags pas 'bul lo/1$0000280 de nas 'khor yum dang bcas pa rang la thim/ rang snying ga'i srog gi hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ me long la has btab pa ltar rim gyis mi dmigs par bsam mo// 1$0000220de lta bus 'bum phrag bzhir bsnyen par bya'o// gnyis pa bsgrub pa la/ gnod sbyin dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ sde brgyad dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ rigs drug dbang du bsdu ba'i man ngag gsum las/ dang po ni/ mdangs 'phrog par byed pa rma bya'i mdangs/ tsha ba bskyed par byed pa tshwa/ chags par byed pa bu ram/ yid rmongs par byed pa shing kun/ gdon bzlog par byed pa gu gul/ yid 'khrul par byed pa thang khrom/ pho thams cad dbang du sdud pa pad+ma'i rak+ta/ mo thams cad dbang du sdud par byed pa byang sems dkar po/ dbang gi las thams cad sgrub par byed pa sin+dhu ra/ mkha' 'gro 'du zhing mnyes par byed pa a mṛ ta dang bcus dbang gis dkyil 'khor zla gam du bris la/ dbus su 'dab bzhi/ de'i lte ba g.yas g.yon du tog dmar po'i tshom bu/ de'i steng du ka pā la bzang po dum bu gsum pa'i nang du khrom tshogs sa dgu'i rde'u/ sde dpon chen po dgu'i bang nas/ dge 'dun gyi sde chen po dgu'i phyags khung gi sa/ bkra shis pa'i sa sna/ rdo sna/ chu klung chen po dang mtsho chen po dgu'i ril bu/

gser dngul yan gyi rin po che/ 'bru shing thog sman kha zas tshogs tshang*/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad kyis bkang*/ de'i steng du dpe ris bzhin du bris pa'i 'khor lo bzhag nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar/ 'khor lo rten rdzas swa bhā was sbyangs nas/ mgon po yab yum 'khor bcas bskyed dgug gzhug dbang bskur ba'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin 'don pa bsgyur bas bya/ tsan dan dmar po'i chu'i mchod yon/ rgya skyegs kyi chu'i zhabs bsil/ me tog dmar po'i rigs/ sih+la la sogs pa'i dri zhim po'i spos/ mdangs bsgyur ba'i mar me/ pad+ma rak+ta'i dri chab/ 'byung rtsi'i khrag byugs pa'i zhal zas/ snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i rol mo rnams/1$0000280 oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ nghū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ gis phul/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ yab yum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i rnam par shes bkug rnam snang gi sgo nas zhugs te a wa nghū tir zhu ba dzaṃ dgu dang baṃ dgu dang bcas par gyur pa yum gyi bha ga zla gam gyi dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas par lhung bas/ dbus su nor rgyun ma/ shar du rab tu dga' ma/ mer lha mo/ lhor 'phags ma/ bden bral du dbyangs can ma/ nub tu chu shel ma/ rlung du rab tu bzang mo/ byang du dga' ma/ dbang ldan du sbas ma/ thams cad kyang sku mdog ser mo phyag na mchog sbyin dang 'bras kyi snye ma/ sgeg pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa rnams la rim pa bzhin du 'khyud pa'i/ dzam+bha la/ yang dag shes/ 'brog gnas/ lngas rtsen/ pi rtsi kuṇ+ḍa li/ rnam sras/ gang bzang*/ nor bu bzang po/ rta bdag thams cad kyang gser btso ma lta bu/ thung zhing lto 'phyang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing bi dza pū ra ka dang ne'u le bsnams pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan la ut+pa la'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa/ mo rnams dang pho'i snying gar zla ba la baṃ dang dzaṃ rang rang gi srog gi ngo bo/

bdag mdun gyi gtso 'khor gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ gsang ba pa'i gnas nas gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu bkug bsgoms pa dang gnyis su med par 1$0000220bsams te/1$0000280 badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan/ trig nan/ dzaṃ baṃ e hur thum dzaḥ.ā kar+ṣā ya hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ1$0000220zhes bos rtags ma byung bar du bzla/ byung nas ting 'dzin sngar gyi khar/1$0000280 1$0000220yab yum sbyor ba byas pa'i rjes su chags pa'i mes gdungs pas gnod sbyin pho mo rnams chags pas myos 'bog brgyal byang sems dkar dmar zags par bsam zhing*/ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān trig nan/ dzaṃ baṃ e hur thum dzaḥmā ra ya rbad/ gzir rtags ma byung bar du/ byung nas sngar gyi khar/ de nas gtso bo'i thur sel gyi rlung bskum pas pho mo rnams kyi nus mtha'i rang bzhin srog gyen tshangs pa'i bu ga nas byung ste/ mdun bskyed kyi shangs nas bdag mgon por gsal ba'i srog la thim pas/ rid cing 'dar ba dang nyam thag pas dbang dang bral te bdag ci bsgo ba khas len cing dbang du 'dus par bsams la/ oṃ ba su dha ri t+yai/ su dat+ta ai/ de w+yai/ ār+yā yai/ sa ra swa t+yai/ tsan+d+ra kan+d+yai/ su bha dra yai/ rat+ta yai/ gu h+yā yai/ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ye/ saṃ pra dzñā nā ye/ gu h+yas+thā na ye/ pañtsi ka ye/ bi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye/ bai shra wa ṇa ye/ pur+ṇa bha drā ye/ ma ṇi bha drā ye/ ku be rā ye/ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ dbang du 'dus rtags ma byung bar du sngar bzhin la mgon po yab yum gyi gsang ba'i sna rtser oṃ āḥdz+riṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las rnam snang*/ rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don grub/ mi bskyod pa/ dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba byang chub mchog dang mchog sbyin ting nge 'dzin skyabs sbyin sa gnon gyi phyag rgya can/ rang rang gi skyil krung gis bzhugs pa rnams 'od du zhu ba'i bdud rtsi lnga'i rgyun gnod sbyin pho mo rnams kyi spyi bor phab lus phyi nang thams cad du khyab pas bkrag mdangs sogs mthu stobs dang ldan te bdag gi las bsgrub pa la gcig tu brtson zhing 'dun par bsams te dzaṃ baṃ brgya rtsa bzla/

gta' gtor gnyis sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs snying po'i sngags kyis phul te/ mthar lha tshogs 'od du zhu ba'i 'khor lo yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsam 'phel 'dod ba'i re ba char bzhin du 'bebs par gyur pa blta'o// gnyis pa sde brgyad dbang du bsdu ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thod pa dum bu brgyad pa/ de'i nang du gri lcags kyi sdig pa la e dang rdo pha wang long bu la tri bris pa dpe ris bzhin gyi 'khor lo bshams nas bdag bskyed 'khor lo sbyangs nas bstod pa'i bar sngar bzhin la/ yab yum gtso 'khor gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi rnam par shes pa bkug rnam snang gi sgo nas a wa dhū tīr zhu ba a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dang bcas par gyur/ yum gyi bha ga zla gam gyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba dang bcas par lhung bas lha ma srin dregs pa sde brgyad pho mo rang rang gi gzugs su snying gar rang rang gi srog gi yi ge dang bcas pa/ bdag mdun gtso 'khor gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros 'jig rten gyi dregs pa can sde brgyad thams cad bsdus/ bsgoms pa dang gnyis su med par bstim ste/ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān trig nan/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na e hur thum dzaḥ.ā kar+ṣā ya hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥzhes dgug rtags ma byung bar bzla/ byung nas sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mthar/ yab yum sbyor ba byas pa'i rjes su chags pa'i mes gdungs pas sde brgyad chags pas brgyal myos 'bog ste rang rang gi dwangs ma zags par bsams la/ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan/ trig nan/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na e hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad ces gzir ba'i mtshan ma ma rnyed bar du'o// ting nge 'dzin snga ma'i kha la/ yab yum gyi thur sel gyi nus par sde brgyad kyi srog tshangs sgo nas shangs kyi bu ga brgyud de bdag gi snar thim pas sde brgyad rid nyams thag 'dar zhing dbang dang bral bas bdag ci bsgo ba nyan par bsams te a ya ma du ru tsa sha na wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes dbang du 'dus rtags ma byung tshun bzla/

gso ba'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin la/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na a mṛ ta hūm̐ zhes bzlas pas bkrag mdangs gsos/ mthu rtsal ldan te bdag gi las bsgrub pa la 'dun cing brtson par gyur/ gtor ma phul/ mthar lha rnams 'od du zhu ba'i 'khor lo rten dang bcas pa sde brgyad kyi snying du gyur te/ de bdag la shor bas ci bgyi ba nyan par bsam mo// gsum pa rigs drug dbang du bsdu ba ni/ dkyil 'khor steng du pho mo'i thod pa kha sbyar/ bris pa'i 'khor lo tsan dan gyi byang bu la gang dbang du bya 'dod pa'i liṅga/ tsan dan gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gzungs thag dang bcas ba bshams/ gzung thag bzung ste bdag mdun bstod pa'i bar/ yab yum gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ gang dbang du bya 'dod pa'i rgyal po btsun mo'am/ dge ba'i bshes sam/ blon po'am/ lha'am klu'am skyes pa dang bud med kyis gtsos pa'i rigs drug thams cad kyi rnam par shes pa bkug rnam snang gi sgo nas a wa dhū tīr byang chub sems su zhu ba a nri su tri pre du trir gyur nas yum gyi bha ga zla gam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rtsibs drug lte ba dang bcas pa'i nang du lhung bas lte bar dbang du bya 'dod pa pho mo/ rtsibs drug la rigs drug pho mo/ mu khyud kyi ā li kā li rnams dpa' bo dang dpa' mor rang rang gi gzugs snying gar srog gi yi ge dang bcas pa bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus rgyal po rigs drug gi sems can thams cad bsdus pa bsgoms pa dang gnyis su med par thim par bsams te/ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān trig nan/ a nri su tri pre du tri e hur thuṃ dzaḥ.ā kar+ṣā ya hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥdagug rtags ma byung bar du sngar gyi khar/ yab yum sbyor ba byas pa'i chags pa'i mes gdungs pas rgyal po sogs rigs drug 'dod chags kyis myos 'bog brgyal dwangs ma 'dzag par bsams te/ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃn/ trig nan a nri su tri pre du tri e hur thum dzaḥmā ra ya rbad/

gzir ba'i mtshan ma ma rnyed bar du/ ting nge 'dzin snga ma'i khar/ yab yum gyi thur sel gyi nus pas rgyal po sogs rigs drug gi srog tshangs pa'i bu ga nas gyen du drangs te shangs nas 'thon/ bdag gi snar zhugs hūm̐ la thim pas de dag rid cing nyam thag 'dar la dbang dang bral bas bdag ci bsgo ba nyan par bsams te/ a nri su tri pre du tri wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ gso ba'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin/ a nri su tri pre du tri a mṛ ta hūm̐/ gtor ma phul/ 'dod don gsol/ 'od du zhu/ 'khor lo la bstim/ 'khor lo so sor dril/ pho 'khor g.yas mo 'khor g.yon pa'i lahwam la bcug gyon/ dmigs pa mkha' 'gro chos skyong rgyal po sogs rigs drug thams cad kyis zhabs 'og nas rin chen 'khor los 'degs par bsgoms/ gzungs thag sked par bcings/ kha ṭ+wāṃ lag tu bzung*/ sna bug g.yon pa'i rlung rgyu dus su phyin na lha chen po dag kyang dbang du 'gyur na 'gro ba gzhan lta ci smos/ gal te gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lo rdugs te las 'gyangs na/ 'khor lo'i dzam+bha la pho mo'i sku la/ dug dang*/ ke tshe dang*/ nim pa'i lo ma dang*/ ngha dhur dang*/ dur khrod kyi sol bas byugs la bsro zhing bskam/ phyin nas dur khrod kyi me la bsros te bdugs na nges par las byed do// sde brgyad kyi las 'gyangs na/ zangs kyi nang du khrag skol la/ stag pa dang glang ma'i byang bu btsos/ de la sde brgyad kyi lid+ga bris/ khog par ming dang srog sngags/ de 'o ma dang khrag skol ba'i nang du bcug rang nyid mgon po 'khor bcas su gsal ba khros 'khrugs pas steng nas dug thun brab cing phur pas dkrug cing bsnun/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri dzaḥyak+ṣa ma tri tsa bh+yo e sde brgyad kyi srog la rbad khug dzaḥzhes bzla'o// des sde brgyad gzi byin nyams te gang bsgo ba nyan no// rgyal po dang yul 'khor dbang du bsdu dka' na/ sde brgyad gnad gzir ba bzhin/

gang 'dod pa'i yul lha'am pho lha la byas pas nges par dbang du 'du'o// gsum pa las la sbyar ba ni/ mar ngo'i stong la tsan dan dmar pos zla gam du byugs pa'i sa'i char pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po bris pa'i dbus su tshom bu bkod/ tsan dan dmar po'am du ru ka'am seng ldeng ngam dmar po'i rigs can shing gang yang rung ba'i bud shing zla gam du brtsig mchod rdzas sreg rdzas rnams sta gon byas la/ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ rang lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las rlung phyir 'byin pa dang lhan cig raṃ dmar po chad de yongs su gyur pa las zla gam dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dbang gi rang bzhin gyi ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong du pad+ma dmar po'i gdan bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis mgon po chags pa'i rdo rje gtso 'khor gsum bskyed/ oṃ mahā kā la shu ra ni/ ī shwa ra ga na pa ti ā kar+ṣā ya hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥnyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bsres/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod cing bstod/ me tog dmar po dang dha nghu ra'i gang bu dang shing*/ til bag phyi bu ram mar rnams sbyar ba'i la du'i ril bu tsan dan dmar pos kha bsgyur ba dang*/ gang 'dod pa'i rin chen/ 'bru sman/ dar dpyangs spel bsgyur te nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ rtsa sngags dang dngos grub bskul ba'i sngags spel te bzla bzhin du g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang srin lag gis blangs la phul/ 'khor bcas tshim zhing dgyes te mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par rang la phul zhing nor dang 'bru dang rin po che dang zas gos la sogs pa'i char gyis rang gi gang khyim bang mdzod yul 'khor la sogs pa'i mthar thug pa gang bar bsam zhing*/

la du sogs zhal dang*/ rin po che la sogs pa mdun dang*/ dar zab sku'i nyer spyad du dmigs te phul/ nongs pa 'chags/ 'dod don gsol/ gshegs su gsol te las kyi rjes mi mngon bar bsdu/ dge ba bsngo/ shis pa rgya cher brjod do// mgon dmar la brten nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin par 'dod na/ dbang gi dkyil 'khor zla gam dbus su pad 'dab bzhi/ g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du me tog dmar po'i tshom bu/ mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ bdag mdun bsgrub mchod bstod gtor ma phul/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod pa'i dbang phyug tshogs kyi rje// re ba'i sems can yid kyi shing rta gang ba'i sde// yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas gyur khyod la bdag slong na// bka' drin bdud rtsi'i ro yis tshim par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon mgon po dmar po yab yum du gsal pa'i spyan sngar sems bskyed pa'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs gsum byas/ slob ma mgon dmar yab yum du bskyed/ bla ma gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba rjes su chags pa'i sbyor bas bskul ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer dmar po rno zhing drag pa nyi ma bye ba'i gdung byed lhag par 'bar ba 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi mgon po gtso 'khor gsum gyi dpral ba'i oṃ gtso bor gyur pa'i lus kyi cha thams cad la phog lus brtan pa dang bral zhing rang nyams med par khyed rang la lhag par 'dud cing rjes su chags pa'i tshul gyis dbang du gyur/ oṃ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bus sa 'og gi dngos grub thams cad bsdus te khyed rang la phul ba 'od zer gyi rnam pas thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi khog pa la bsdu/ sku'i dngos grub thams cad rang dbang du gyur cing thogs pa med pa'i nus pa thob par bsam/ de bzhin du 'od zer mgrin pa'i āḥgatso bor gyur pa'i ngag gi gnas thams cad la phog

ngag brtan pa dang bral zhing rang nyams med par khyed ci bsgo ba khas len pa'i tshul gyis dbang du gyur/ āḥyig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bus sa steng na spyod pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsdus te khyed rang la phul bas 'od zer gyi rnam pas hūm̐ gi zla tshes la bsdu/ gsung gi dngos grub thams cad la rang dbang du gyur cing thogs pa med pa'i nus pa thon par bsam/ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ gtso bor gyur pa'i yid kyi gnas thams cad la phog yid brtan pa dang bral zhing rang nyams med par khyed rang gi yid bzhin du 'jug pa'i tshul gyis dbang du gyur/ hūm̐ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus sa bla na spyod pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsdus te khyed rang la phul ba 'od zer gyi rnam pas hūm̐ gi thig le la bsdu/ thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad la rang dbang du gyur cing thogs pa med pa'i nus pa thon par bsam/ sngags las byung ba'i 'od zer dmar po srid pa gsum gang bar 'phros pa rnams kyis snod bcud kyi 'byor pa longs spyod phun tshogs mdangs bcud ci yod pa thams cad lhag ma med par bsdus te khyod rang la dngos grub kyi tshul du phul ba 'od zer gyi rnam pas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la srog gtad bzung ba'i tshul gyis ro gcig tu 'dres par bsams la/ oṃ mahā kā la shū ra ni/ e mañdzu kup+ta hūm̐/ ka bher ko bha ri ga na pa ti swā hā/ zhes bzlas lung sbyin/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i me tog spyi bor bzhag bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// nus pa brtan par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ maṇ+ḍal dang yon 'bul lo// de ltar mgon dmar chags pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa slob dpon dril bu pa'i man ngag la brten nas pad+ma dkar pos rgyal byed tshal du sbyar ba'o// mad+ga laṃ/// /1$0000280
